svg.title: Obituary lifecycle
svg.desc: Register (obit add, or use the context menu) → expire (obit list shows what is left) → reap into the graveyard (obit graveyard, kept 7 days by default) → resurrect (obit resurrect, back where it was, never overwrite), or permanently delete after retention (obit purge).
